question: ‘Chitra, a Play in One Act’ was written by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rabindranath Tagore.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ‘Chitra, a Play in One Act’ was written by **Rabindranath Tagore.**
 
• ‘Gitanjali’ is one of the most notable works of Rabindranath Tagore.
 
• It is a collection of poems originally published in 1910.
 
• Tagore was the first non-European to win the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1913.
 
• Some of his other prominent works are Kabuliwala, Chokher Bali, The Post Office, etc.
 
• He also composed ‘Jana Gana Mana,’ the National Anthem of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rabindranath Tagore was born on 7th May 1861 in the Bengali Brahim family. He was the youngest of thirteen children in the Jorasanko Bhavan in Calcutta (Kolkata) to Debendranath Tagore (Father) and Sarada Devi (Mother).
 
• He was the first non-European and first from Asia who was conferred with the Nobel Prize in Literature for the extraordinary "Gitanjali" in 1913.
 
• In 1915, he was awarded an order of knighthood by King George V, but later on, he abandoned the Knighthood because of the Jalliahwala Massacre in 1919.
 
• Rabindranath Tagore founded the famous Visha-Bharati (Santiniketan) in 1917.
